reference_sql:
WITH promo_products AS (
  -- one row per promotion that started in Q3 2025 and product in it
  SELECT p.promo_id, pp.product_id, p.start_date, p.end_date
  FROM promotions AS p
  JOIN promotion_products AS pp ON pp.promo_id = p.promo_id
  WHERE p.start_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-01' AND DATE '2025-09-30'
),
weekly_averages AS (
  -- one row per promotion and product
  SELECT x.promo_id, x.product_id,
         AVG(CASE WHEN w.week_start >= x.start_date - INTERVAL 28 DAY
                   AND w.week_start < x.start_date THEN w.units END) AS baseline_units_wk,
         AVG(CASE WHEN w.week_start BETWEEN x.start_date AND x.end_date THEN w.units END) AS promo_units_wk
  FROM promo_products AS x
  JOIN weekly_units AS w ON w.product_id = x.product_id
  GROUP BY x.promo_id, x.product_id
)
SELECT promo_id, product_id, baseline_units_wk, promo_units_wk,
       ROUND(100.0 * (promo_units_wk - baseline_units_wk) / NULLIF(baseline_units_wk, 0), 1) AS uplift_pct
FROM weekly_averages
ORDER BY uplift_pct DESC NULLS LAST, promo_id, product_id

WITH promo_products AS (
  -- one row per promotion that started in Q3 2025 and product in it
  SELECT p.promo_id, pp.product_id, p.start_date, p.end_date
  FROM promotions AS p
  JOIN promotion_products AS pp ON pp.promo_id = p.promo_id
  WHERE p.start_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-01' AND DATE '2025-09-30'
),
baseline AS (
  -- one row per promotion and product: its 4 weeks before the start
  SELECT x.promo_id, x.product_id, AVG(w.units) AS baseline_units_wk
  FROM promo_products AS x
  JOIN weekly_units AS w ON w.product_id = x.product_id
  WHERE w.week_start BETWEEN x.start_date - INTERVAL 28 DAY AND x.start_date - INTERVAL 7 DAY
  GROUP BY x.promo_id, x.product_id
),
promo_weeks AS (
  -- one row per promotion and product: its promotion weeks
  SELECT x.promo_id, x.product_id, AVG(w.units) AS promo_units_wk
  FROM promo_products AS x
  JOIN weekly_units AS w ON w.product_id = x.product_id
  WHERE w.week_start BETWEEN x.start_date AND x.end_date
  GROUP BY x.promo_id, x.product_id
)
SELECT b.promo_id, b.product_id, b.baseline_units_wk, pw.promo_units_wk,
       ROUND(100.0 * (pw.promo_units_wk - b.baseline_units_wk) / NULLIF(b.baseline_units_wk, 0), 1) AS uplift_pct
FROM baseline AS b
JOIN promo_weeks AS pw ON pw.promo_id = b.promo_id AND pw.product_id = b.product_id
ORDER BY uplift_pct DESC NULLS LAST, b.promo_id, b.product_id

SELECT t.promo_id, t.product_id, t.baseline_units_wk, t.promo_units_wk,
       ROUND(100.0 * (t.promo_units_wk - t.baseline_units_wk) / NULLIF(t.baseline_units_wk, 0), 1) AS uplift_pct
FROM (
  -- one row per promotion and product
  SELECT p.promo_id, pp.product_id,
         SUM(CASE WHEN w.week_start < p.start_date THEN w.units END) * 1.0
           / COUNT(CASE WHEN w.week_start < p.start_date THEN 1 END) AS baseline_units_wk,
         SUM(CASE WHEN w.week_start >= p.start_date THEN w.units END) * 1.0
           / COUNT(CASE WHEN w.week_start >= p.start_date THEN 1 END) AS promo_units_wk
  FROM promotions AS p
  JOIN promotion_products AS pp ON pp.promo_id = p.promo_id
  JOIN weekly_units AS w ON w.product_id = pp.product_id
   AND w.week_start BETWEEN p.start_date - INTERVAL 28 DAY AND p.end_date
  WHERE p.start_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-01' AND DATE '2025-09-30'
  GROUP BY p.promo_id, pp.product_id
) AS t
ORDER BY uplift_pct DESC NULLS LAST, t.promo_id, t.product_id

solver.query:
WITH pr AS (SELECT promo_id, CAST(start_date AS DATE) AS s, CAST(end_date AS DATE) AS e FROM promotions WHERE CAST(start_date AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-01' AND DATE '2025-09-30'),
pp AS (SELECT pr.promo_id, pr.s, pr.e, x.product_id FROM pr JOIN promotion_products x ON x.promo_id = pr.promo_id),
agg AS (SELECT pp.promo_id, pp.product_id,
  SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(w.week_start AS DATE) >= pp.s - 28 AND CAST(w.week_start AS DATE) < pp.s THEN w.units END) / 4.0 AS baseline_units_wk,
  AVG(CASE WHEN CAST(w.week_start AS DATE) BETWEEN pp.s AND pp.e THEN w.units END) AS promo_units_wk
 FROM pp JOIN weekly_units w ON w.product_id = pp.product_id GROUP BY pp.promo_id, pp.product_id)
SELECT promo_id, product_id, baseline_units_wk, promo_units_wk,
 ROUND(100 * (promo_units_wk - baseline_units_wk) / NULLIF(baseline_units_wk, 0), 1) AS uplift_pct
FROM agg ORDER BY uplift_pct DESC NULLS LAST, promo_id, product_id
